parsed_action.body:
The next phase must distinguish mechanisms that earned a role from those that were only behaviorally active, locally harmful, blocked, or still untested. The evidence base shows that exact external custody and reactive reentry are qualified substrates [S09][S10]. Deterministic first-fit relief is qualified but narrowly applicable [S02]. Batch ingress and semantic sidecars were behaviorally active but did not produce cumulative task-artifact work [S08]. Model-owned eviction, automatic phase discovery, and general architecture promotion remain unvalidated [S02][S10].

The scope excludes claims that artifact coupling, notes, digests, progress state, or a general architecture are already validated. The decision addresses only mechanisms with current candidate-bound evidence. Conditions that would falsify the recommended next policy include: (1) if fresh transfer experiments show no joint effect across independent worlds; (2) if stopping rules are violated by v3 variants of failed designs; (3) if evaluation/readiness lineage fails to establish candidate-bound currentness [S02][S12]. The program must maintain exact external custody and reopenability as a foundational constraint [S04][S13].
parsed_action.heading: Decision and scope
